extraction.name: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB)
extraction.description: A benchmark for evaluating text embedding models across 8 embedding tasks, covering 58 datasets and 112 languages. It is designed to assess performance on a broad range of use cases including clustering, reranking, retrieval, STS, and summarization.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The benchmark was created using available data from Reddit posts, and the clustering task uses the concatenation of title+post according to subreddit.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Reddit posts; text examples include title and post content used for clustering by subreddit.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The benchmark is biased toward tasks with many datasets, notably retrieval, classification, and clustering; retrieval and clustering are English-only, while multilingual coverage is limited.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Very long documents are missing; multilingual retrieval and clustering are not comprehensively covered; there are no code datasets; the benchmark focuses solely on natural language applications and leaves other modalities to future work.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper does not explicitly discuss broader social impacts beyond benchmarking coverage and applicability.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset examples include language and geography-related content, and some datasets contain user-generated text from Reddit and Twitter; no explicit sensitive attributes are described as collected variables.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Used for benchmarking text embedding models across tasks such as classification, retrieval, pair classification, clustering, reranking, and summarization; the paper presents examples and evaluation results for these tasks.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The paper indicates the benchmark will be extended with more datasets over time, but does not specify a formal versioning, maintainer, update timeframe, or deprecation policy.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The clustering task uses the concatenation of title+post according to subreddit; the paper also notes that MTEB uses available data from Reddit posts.
